### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing funcscan pipeline output (reports/, cazyme/, multiqc/) |
| `SAMPLESHEET_FILE` | — | Path to the funcscan samplesheet (sample,fasta). Auto-detected from {DATA_ROOT}/input/ when omitted. The AWS megatest does not publish it; see megatest.yaml post_fetch_help for the curl line. |
| `SKIP_ARG` | — | Set (--var SKIP_ARG=true) for a run without --run_arg_screening. Prunes the hAMRonization data collections and the Resistome tab. |
| `SKIP_AMP` | — | Set (--var SKIP_AMP=true) for a run without --run_amp_screening. Prunes the AMPcombi data collections and the AMPs tab. |
| `SKIP_BGC` | — | Set (--var SKIP_BGC=true) for a run without --run_bgc_screening. Prunes the comBGC data collections and the BGCs tab. |
| `SKIP_CAZYME` | — | Set (--var SKIP_CAZYME=true) for a run without --run_cazyme_screening. Prunes the run_dbCAN data collections and the CAZymes tab. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`ampcombi/clusters.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ampcombi/clusters.py) | AMP sequence clusters from the AMPcombi ``cluster`` representative table. | `cluster_id`, `representative`, `sample`, `members` |
| [`ampcombi/embedding.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ampcombi/embedding.py) | PCA embedding of AMP candidates over their physicochemical properties. | `cds_id`, `dim_1`, `dim_2`, `sample`, `prob_ampir`, `prob_macrel`, `prob_max`, `charge_class`, `aa_length` |
| [`ampcombi/summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ampcombi/summary.py) | Tidy the AMPcombi ``complete`` summary: one row per AMP candidate. | `sample`, `cds_id`, `contig`, `prob_ampir`, `prob_macrel`, `prob_amplify`, `prob_max`, `n_tools`, `aa_length`, `molecular_weight`, `isoelectric_point`, `hydrophobicity`, `helix_fraction`, `turn_fraction`, `sheet_fraction`, `charge_class`, `transporter_protein`, `stop_codon`, `cds_start`, `cds_end`, `strand`, `db_hit`, `db_description`, `db_evalue`, `db_pident`, `aa_sequence` |
| [`combgc/summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/combgc/summary.py) | Tidy the comBGC complete summary into one row per predicted BGC region. | `sample`, `contig`, `tool`, `product_class`, `probability`, `complete`, `start`, `end`, `length`, `cds_count`, `n_pfam`, `pfam_domains`, `mibig_id`, `regions` |
| [`combgc/tool_overlap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/combgc/tool_overlap.py) | Contig by tool membership matrix for an UpSet plot of BGC caller agreement. | `contig`, `sample` |
| [`dbcan/overview.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/dbcan/overview.py) | Tidy the run_dbCAN ``overview.tsv`` files into one row per CAZyme gene. | `sample`, `gene_id`, `contig`, `hmmer`, `dbcan_sub`, `diamond`, `n_tools`, `family`, `cazy_class`, `substrate`, `ec_number`, `genes` |
| [`dbcan/substrates.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/dbcan/substrates.py) | CAZyme gene cluster (CGC) substrate predictions from run_dbCAN. | `sample`, `cgc_id`, `contig`, `pul_id`, `substrate`, `bitscore`, `sub_substrate`, `sub_score`, `clusters` |
| [`dbcan/tool_overlap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/dbcan/tool_overlap.py) | Gene by tool membership matrix for an UpSet plot of dbCAN tool agreement. | `gene_id`, `sample`, `hmmer`, `dbcan_sub`, `diamond` |
| [`hamronization/gene_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hamronization/gene_matrix.py) | Gene by sample ARG hit matrix for a clustered heatmap. | `gene_symbol`, `drug_class`, `drug_class_primary` |
| [`hamronization/gene_presence.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hamronization/gene_presence.py) | Per sample and gene ARG presence: how many hits, how many tools agree. | `sample`, `gene_symbol`, `drug_class`, `hits`, `n_tools`, `tool_frac`, `mean_identity`, `mean_coverage` |
